jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript & Cloud)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an energetic Full Stack Engineer to build next-generation data applications.
Responsibilities:
- Build modular React interfaces and robust Node.js / TypeScript microservices.
- Design performant PostgreSQL schemas and implement caching strategies.
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize services using Docker, and contribute to code reviews.
Requirements:
- 1-3 years of full-stack engineering experience.
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and SQL/PostgreSQL.
- Familiarity with Docker and Git workflows.
- Nice to have: GraphQL, Redis, AWS services.

responsibilities: Build modular React interfaces and robust Node.js microservices
Maintain CI/CD pipelines and Docker containerization

partial_skills: AWS (AWS Cloud Practitioner noted in progress)
job_matches.experience_alignment: Strong direct match with 1.5 years experience in React/Node/PostgreSQL and unit testing.
recommended_improvements: Add a sample or personal project demonstrating Redis caching or GraphQL querying.
Specify CI/CD pipeline automation tools used in previous deployments.

skill_goals.why_matters: Essential for high-throughput microservices and reducing PostgreSQL read load.
skill_goals.candidate_evidence: Solid understanding of backend request life cycles and relational databases.
skill_goals.learning_objective: Implement Redis cache-aside pattern with TTL invalidation on REST endpoints.
skill_goals.recommended_exercise: Build a Node.js caching middleware using ioredis for frequent database queries.

skill_goals.why_matters: Enables flexible data fetching and minimizes network over-fetching in complex UI views.
skill_goals.candidate_evidence: Deep proficiency in RESTful design and TypeScript typing.
skill_goals.learning_objective: Create a GraphQL schema with Apollo Server and TypeScript resolvers.
skill_goals.recommended_exercise: Expose a GraphQL endpoint querying existing PostgreSQL tables with field-level resolvers.

strengths: Clear explanation of database diagnostics and indexing
areas_to_improve: Expand on distributed state handling and asynchronous task queues
interview_sessions.summary: Strong technical communication with practical system debugging experience.

interview_questions.question_text: In your resume, you mentioned optimizing PostgreSQL queries at CloudVibe Systems. How did you identify the slow queries, and what indexing or query structure changes did you make?
interview_questions.context_clue: Focus on query profiling (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) and index strategies.

interview_answers.answer_text: We monitored slow endpoints in our logs and used EXPLAIN ANALYZE on our PostgreSQL queries. We identified sequential scans on our payments table where a composite index on user_id and created_at was missing. After adding the B-tree index and rewriting a subquery into a JOIN, query latency dropped significantly.

interview_feedback.what_went_well: Demonstrated precise knowledge of EXPLAIN ANALYZE, composite B-tree indexing, and converting subqueries to JOINs.
interview_feedback.what_to_improve: Could mention monitoring index write overhead or query planning cache implications.
missing_points: Index maintenance costs and connection pooling considerations
interview_feedback.suggested_approach: Excellent answer. Highlighting connection pooling or pg_stat_statements adds senior-level depth.
interview_feedback.follow_up_tip: Ready to tackle deeper concurrency questions.
